title: Global Raven-HBV control and conserving channel-routing ablation
locked_discharge_forbidden: 2019-2022 discharge file must not be opened

candidates.GLOBAL_HBV_R0: one global 8-parameter Raven-equation-conformant land model plus instantaneous conserving topology accumulation
candidates.GLOBAL_HBV_R1: same fitted land parameters without refit, plus adaptive conserving hydraulic channel storage
candidates.Q72_MONTHLY_REFERENCE: frozen operational monthly reference, diagnostic only

fit_contract.objective: tree-equal then station-equal mean squared error in ln(1+Q), plus station volume-bias term and frozen Gaussian raw-parameter prior

gauge_operator.R0: all upstream local volume plus registered fraction of the target-Reach local volume
gauge_operator.R1: linear interpolation between target-Reach upstream boundary inflow and downstream outflow at the registered along-Reach fraction

R1_hydraulics.discharge: candidate own daily instantaneous Q0+Q1+Q2 accumulation
R1_hydraulics.geometry: Andreadis width/depth central values and Reach length

route_selection: R1 advances only if paired station and terminal-tree bootstrap CI95 upper bounds for delta station log-RMSE are both <0 and monthly absolute PBIAS does not worsen by >1 percentage point; otherwise R0 advances
forbidden: daily hydrograph separation as a likelihood
calling Q2 observed groundwater, old water or water age
